# ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup_list (Data Source)

Use this data source to list the Point In Time (PIT) backups of an Azure key known to CipherTrust Manager. The `id` of a returned backup can be used as `restore_key.backup_id` in the ciphertrust_azure_key resource. Unless `skip` or `limit` is set in `filters`, all pages are retrieved.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Notes
# - key_id is the CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the key.
# - Backups are sorted newest first by default (sort = "-createdAt").
# - All filter values must be strings.

# List all PIT backups of a key
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup_list" "backups" {
  key_id = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
}

# List the PIT backups of a key with filters
data "ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup_list" "filtered" {
  key_id = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
  filters = {
    name  = "rsa-key-backup"
    limit = "5"
  }
}

# The newest backup is the first entry. Use it to restore the key.
output "latest_backup_id" {
  value = data.ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup_list.backups.backups[0].id
}

resource "ciphertrust_azure_key" "restored_key" {
  vault_id = ciphertrust_azure_vault.other_vault.id
  restore_key = {
    key_id    = ciphertrust_azure_key.rsa_key.id
    backup_id = data.ciphertrust_azure_key_pit_backup_list.backups.backups[0].id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the Azure key whose PIT backups are listed.

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) A map of key/value pairs matching CipherTrust Manager API query parameters for listing Azure key PIT backups.

> **Note:** Although some filters represent integers or booleans, all filter values must be specified as strings. For example, use `"true"` rather than `true`.

| filter            | type    | description |
|-------------------|---------|-------------|
| skip              | integer | Index of the first result to return. If `skip` or `limit` is set, only one page is requested. |
| limit             | integer | Maximum number of results to return (default: 10). If `skip` or `limit` is set, only one page is requested. |
| sort              | string  | Fields to sort by. Prefix with `-` for descending order (default: `-createdAt`). |
| backup_id         | string  | Filter by CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the PIT backup. |
| name              | string  | Filter by backup name. |
| backup            | string  | Filter by the CipherTrust Manager opaque object ID of the backup. |
| vault_name        | string  | Filter by Azure vault name. |
| subscription_id   | string  | Filter by subscription ID. |
| subscription_name | string  | Filter by subscription name. |
| region            | string  | Filter by region. |
| type              | string  | Filter by backup type. |
| gone              | boolean | Filter by gone. |
| tenant            | string  | Filter by tenant. |
| cloud_name        | string  | Filter by cloud name (for example, `AzureCloud`). |

### Read-Only

- `backups` (Attributes List) List of PIT backups of the key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backups))
- `matched` (Number) Total number of backups matching the given filters.

<a id="nestedatt--backups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `backups`

Read-Only:

- `backup` (String) CipherTrust Manager opaque object ID holding the backup.
- `cloud_name` (String) Cloud name as returned by CipherTrust Manager.
- `created_at` (String) Time the backup was created in CipherTrust Manager.
- `description` (String) Description of the backup.
- `gone` (Boolean) Whether the backed up key no longer exists in Azure.
- `id` (String) CipherTrust Manager resource ID of the PIT backup.
- `key_name` (String) Azure name of the backed up key.
- `key_vault` (String) Key vault of the backed up key in the format vault_name::subscription_id.
- `name` (String) Name of the backup.
- `region` (String) Azure region of the key vault.
- `subscription_id` (String) Azure subscription ID.
- `subscription_name` (String) Azure subscription name.
- `tenant` (String) Azure tenant ID.
- `type` (String) Type of the backup.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the backup was last updated in CipherTrust Manager.
- `vault_name` (String) Name of the key vault the key belongs to.
